const original = $('WF01 Double Theme Logger Prep').first().json;
return [{ json: original }];

const prev = $('Assemble Proxy Data').first().json;
if (prev.decision === 'BLOCKED' || prev.decision === 'DUPLICATE_REQUEST') {
  return [{ json: prev }];
}
const normalizedItems = prev.items.map(function(item) {
  return {
    asin: (item.asin || '').trim(),
    sku: (item.sku || '').trim(),
    brand: (item.brand || '').trim(),
    normalized_brand: (item.normalized_brand || item.brand || '').toLowerCase().trim(),
    product_type: (item.product_type || 'CLOTHING').toUpperCase().trim(),
    normalized_product_type: (item.product_type || 'CLOTHING').toUpperCase().trim(),
    category: (item.category || '').trim(),
    normalized_category: (item.category || '').toLowerCase().trim(),
    parent_sku: item.parent_sku || null,
    parentage: item.parentage || null,
    variation_value: item.variation_value || null,
    variation_values: item.variation_values || null,
    matrix_assignments: item.matrix_assignments || null,
    color_name: item.color_name || null,
    size_name: item.size_name || null,
    variation_theme: item.variation_theme || null,
    supported_variation_themes: item.supported_variation_themes || [],
    listing_issues: item.listing_issues || [],
    theme_attribute_status: 'unverified',
    data_source: 'mock'
  };
});
return [{ json: {
  request_id: prev.request_id,
  decision: prev.decision,
  message: prev.message,
  request_text: prev.request_text || null,
  variation_structure: prev.variation_structure,
  sizes: prev.sizes || null,
  colors: prev.colors || null,
  matrix_assignments: prev.matrix_assignments || null,
  simulate_missing_value: prev.simulate_missing_value || false,
  items: normalizedItems,
  normalized: true,
  data_source: 'mock',
  required_parent_attributes: prev.required_parent_attributes || [],
  required_child_attributes: prev.required_child_attributes || []
}}];

const original = $('AI Logger Prep (Single)').first().json;
return [{ json: original }];
